notes.title: Blasted Dice Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you are having a good time with the game!

Today, I'm releasing a small hotfix just to clarify some item and keepsake tooltips.

Specifically, all items and keepsakes that add max health had their tooltips changed to also mentioning adding plain health.

Example:
Green Shard was changed from:
'[i]+250 max health.[/i]' -> '[i]+250 health and max health.[/i]'

Also, all mentions of hp have been changed to health.

That's about it! Thanks again for playing the game!

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Starting Decks and QoL Changes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you the second full release devlog!
These devlogs should come out once every week or so, up until the game releases.

[h2]Starting Decks[/h2]
Every time you start a new run, you will be able to choose a deck to start with! Right now, there are 6 starting decks in the game you can choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/5b8434940ff4e3f4f7d43483bced06cbe958d054.png[/img]

They will be unlocked gradually as you complete runs. As it is right now, you'll get a new deck after playing a set number of runs (no wins needed!).
You will start with the original 12 normal dice deck when you first start playing the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/ee2995ce8024197a97db3a6c85d3b21679cc5ffb.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
You are now able to check dice, item and keepsake tooltips when doing actions such as attacking, blocking or rerolling! This was not possible before, but after seeing people playing the game, this felt like a needed change. Especially, if you are still learning what each item does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/b97de1ea95265f3a3504306a43d2a3e7dbff40e9.png[/img]

And that's about it for this week! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out through our Discord, the Steam Community, or Email.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/jUZnFeAjse


I'll be back next week or so, for another devlog!
Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Small Demo Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Turns out Poseidon's Trident ([i]+1 max playing dice per turn (max: 4). +6 initial multiplier.[/i]) was bugged.
It was multiplying the initial multiplier by 5 instead of adding 5.
It's now fixed and the value was changed from 5 to 6.
Runs will not be reset, but if you have any problems with the item on an old run (before the fix), best option will be to start a fresh new run!

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo QoL/Balance Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a brand new patch, with some changes to improve visibility and some bug fixes.
This is gonna be the last big demo patch, as I go back to finishing the full release version. Any demo patch after this, if any, will be for major bug fixes (if they occur). Expect some development updates here and in the discord, once in a while (around once every two weeks).
Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

[h2]An Improved Sign[/h2]
The 'Continue Sign' has been improved! It now has a golden arrow, is a bit larger and is brighter when in 'The Shadows'. This change was made to improve the sign's visibility, as well as making it easier to click on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/af4fb138d1acf357f6f03a467f0d9cf1cfc9ef37.png[/img]

[h2]Main Menu Changes[/h2]
Added 2 new buttons to the main menu! One invites you to the Community Discord, while the other opens the game's news page on Steam.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Siren Pearl ([b]Passive[/b], [i]Actives sell for 100% more.[/i]) now works with ingots (actives that sell for gold).
[*]Settings button now correctly appears below the dice box, combos and stats panels (when they are open).
[*]Rounded end game damage stats on game over/victory window.
[*]Added a Blasted Dice 48x48 icon for Windows applications (was previously missing).
[/list]
Thanks so much for playing the demo and wishlisting the game! I'll be back soon with some content news, here and there, about the full release.

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo QoL/Balance Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a brand new patch, with some new quality of life options to make the game more streamlined. Also, there's a few balance changes.
Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

[h2]Combat Speed[/h2]
Combat Speed can now be changed in the settings menu! There are 4 new speed levels(1,2,3 and 4), each one making the combat animations increasingly faster! Combat Speed level 1 is the original that has been in the game since the start. Combat Speed level 4 is the one in the gif below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/901169551db352afe8c62c62d7fefda8afb5d9d7.gif[/img]


[h2]Streamlined Shop Animations[/h2]
Most shop animations, from buying dice to selling or buying items have been changed to be almost instant. This makes it so you don't have to wait to buy or sell items in bulk, leading to a more streamlined shop experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/4ed5372710c4ec819cf3a71febc8baed777cfd6a.gif[/img]


[h2]Enemy Changes[/h2]

[b]Swordsman(round 8, 18 and 28):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]moveset[/b] from [b]attack/attack/reroll/reroll/heal to attack/reroll/attack/reroll/reroll/heal[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Item Changes[/h2]

[h3]Passives[/h3]
[b]Singularity[/b]
[i]If you play only 1 dice, +12 multiplier and +12 score.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]10/10 to 12/12[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Dice Changes[/h2]

[b]Inverted Dice[/b]
[i]Die face gives multiplier instead of score.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]200 to 100 gold[/b].
[/list]
Thank you so much to everyone that played the demo and/or added the game to their wishlist during the Steam Next Fest. Hope these changes make the demo better for you all!

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo Balance/Rework Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a brand new patch, with lots of changes and a big rework to 'The Shadows'!
Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

[h2]The Shadows Rework[/h2]
'The Shadows' have been [b]reworked[/b] to now being a [b]choice between adding initial score and initial multiplier[/b](initial meaning before all other calculations).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/7b0b39c0373f658c7fc54138acad8d6e213a5f51.png[/img]
This change was made due to the earlier version being much more luck dependent, leading to times where you would entirely skip it, or you would end up too focused on a build with no chance to pivot to another.
That being said, to accomodate this rework, a lot of changes to enemies, items and other aspects had to be made, which can be found below.

[h2]Enemy Changes[/h2]

[b]Yellow Fighter(round 26):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]block value[/b] from [b]5400 to 4800[/b].
[*]Changed [b]damage value[/b] from [b]4200/4800/5400 to 4200/4500/4800[/b].
[/list]
[b]Yellow Shielded Fighter(round 27):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]block value[/b] from [b]6000 to 5100[/b].
[*]Changed [b]damage value[/b] from [b]6000 to 5100[/b].
[/list]
[b]Yellow Swordsman(round 28):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]damage value[/b] from [b]5400/6600 to 5100/5400[/b].
[/list]
[b]Yellow Hoplite(round 29):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]block value[/b] from [b]9000 to 7200[/b].
[*]Changed [b]damage value[/b] from [b]6600/7200 to 5400/6000[/b].
[/list]
[b]The Gambler(round 30):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]moveset[/b] from [b]reroll/attack to reroll/attack/reroll[/b].
[/list]
[b]Crimson Snake(round 31):[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]block value[/b] from [b]12000 to 10200[/b].
[*]Changed [b]damage value[/b] from [b]9000 to 7500[/b].
[*]Changed [b]healing percentage[/b] from [b]10% to 1% of max health[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Item Changes[/h2]

[h3]Passives[/h3]
[b]Four-Leaf Clover[/b]
[i]You get a random active whenever you buy a passive.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]100 to 50 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Change of Ways[/b]
[i]+10 healing dice multiplier.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]400 to 300 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Shark Tooth[/b]
[i]+?/100 multiplier on attacks. ? is the last block score, this round.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]400 to 350 gold[/b].
[*]Changed [b]divider value[/b] from [b]125 to 100[/b].
[/list]
[b]Buckler[/b]
[i]On the first time you would be defeated, remain at 1 hp, once per round.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]100 to 75 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Lyre Harp[/b]
[i]When pressing the reroll button, if you have no dice selected, you reroll all dice.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]100 to 50 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Coin of a True Soldier[/b]
[i]All items in the shop are 30% cheaper.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]300 to 250 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Pomegranate[/b]
[i]Heal dice heal 3x more when played.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]100 to 50 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]Toasty[/b]
[i]If you only have normal dice in your deck, 2x final score.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]400 to 300 gold[/b].
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]1.5 to 2[/b].
[/list]
[b]Red Amphora[/b]
[i]x3 initial multiplier.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]4 to 3[/b].
[/list]
[b]Lost Ways[/b]
[i]x1.5 multiplier on up and down dice.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]1.6 to 1.5[/b].
[/list]
[b]The Last Stone[/b]
[i]+16 score on blocks.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]12 to 16[/b].
[/list]
[b]Zeus' Sceptre[/b]
[i]+1 max dice per turn (max: 4). +115 final score per enemy defeated.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]100 to 115[/b].
[/list]
[b]Artemis' Quiver[/b]
[i]+0.6 score for each die in the deck.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]0.3 to 0.6[/b].
[/list]
[b]Red Herring[/b]
[i]+3 normal dice multiplier.[/i]
[list]

[/list]

[i]+6 die face score to each die with a face equal to 1.[/i]

[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]4 to 6[/b].

[i]x4 multiplier on 'None' combos.[/i]
[list]

[/list]
[b]Crimson Alpha[/b]
[i]x4 multiplier on 'Ace' combos.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]2 to 4[/b].
[/list]
[b]Cerulean Alpha[/b]
[i]+24 score on 'None' combos.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]12 to 24[/b].
[/list]
[b]Amethyst Alpha[/b]
[i]+30 score on 'Ace' combos.[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]value[/b] from [b]12 to 30[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Actives[/h3]
[b]Asclepius' Potion[/b]
[i]If you would be defeated, remain at 1 hp (once per use).[/i]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]100 to 75 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Dice Changes[/h2]

[b]Critical Dice[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]cost[/b] from [b]300 to 200 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]starting deck size[/b] from [b]16 to 12 dice[/b].
[*]Changed dice face outcome logic on most dice.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Artemis' Quiver and Apollo's Bow and Arrow not updating their score and multiplier values on dice deck changes.
[*]Fixed tooltip showing the wrong sell price for actives.
[/list]
Thank you so much for playing the demo! Remember to add the game to your wishlist, if you haven't yet!

[b]Steam Next Fest[/b] starts in less than 48 hours, so a balance patch should be released some time next week, after I get some more feedback.

Thank you for reading! Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo Balance Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
Today, I'm releasing a new balance patch to address round progression problems and some other issues. Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

[h3]Enemy Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]Hoplite's[/b](round 9, 19 and 29) [b]moveset[/b] (he now heals less often).
[*]Changed [b]Hoplite's[/b](round 9, 19 and 29) [b]heal percentage[/b] from [b]20%->15% of max health[/b].
[*]Changed [b]Blue Hoplite's[/b](round 19) [b]damage[/b] from [b]800/850->700/800[/b].
[*]Removed [b]healing[/b] from [b]Shielded Fighter's[/b](round 7, 17 and 27) [b]moveset[/b].
[*]Changed [b]Red Shielded Fighter's[/b](round 7) [b]block value[/b] from [b]60->35[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Item Changes:[/h3]
Actives:
[list]
[*][b]Throwing Axe[/b] - Deals [b]50 damage[/b] to an enemy. -> Deals [b]'35 x round number' damage[/b] to an enemy.
[*][b]Red Marble[/b] - [b]+3 multiplier[/b] on next action. -> [b]+6 multiplier[/b] on next action.
[*][b]Potion of Fortitude[/b] - [b]+3 multiplier[/b] on next block. -> [b]+4 multiplier[/b] on next block.
[*][b]Potion of Rage[/b] - [b]+3 multiplier[/b] on next attack. -> [b]+4 multiplier[/b] on next attack.
[/list]
Passives:
[list]
[*][b]Telegonus' Spear[/b] - [b]+5 multiplier[/b] for each attack die played. -> [b]+6 multiplier[/b] for each attack die played.
[*][b]Anchor[/b] - [b]+5 multiplier[/b] for each block die played. -> [b]+6 multiplier[/b] for each block die played.
[/list]
[h3]Shop Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]dice removal cost[/b] from [b]60->50 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Bug/Other Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where dice would remain selected after going back to main menu, and then returning back to combat.
[*]Fixed some grammar errors.
[/list]
Thanks so much for playing the demo and giving great feedback! I expect to release another patch later this week, as we get closer and closer to Steam Next Fest.

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo
